crossRefs.note: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance…

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
translations.bsb: So Ephraim and Manasseh, the sons of Joseph, received their inheritance.
translations.kjv: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
translations.asv: And the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
